name: Gloomtide Strand
summary: Gloomtide Strand is a stretch of western Darkshore coastline facing the Veiled Sea. In these tranquil yet somber years, it remains a quiet coastal shore under the ancient guardianship of the night elves, undisturbed by large military encroachments.

sections.title: A Fog-Shrouded Shore
sections.body: Stretching along the misty perimeter of Darkshore, this coastal strand looks out across cold tides and wind-battered sands. Like much of the surrounding territory, it sits under the quiet watch of the night elves, who dwell among the brooding woodlands and misty beaches of northern Kalimdor. Though remote, the shoreline shares in Darkshore's characteristic gloom, washed by cold waters and framed by ancient coastal pines.

sections.title: Winds of the Veiled Sea
sections.body: Darkshore's beaches are frequently buffeted by squalls and littered with flotsam carried ashore from shipwrecks and ancient ruins. The strand remains an isolated and wild stretch of coastline, untouched by the larger military encampments that dominate more contested frontiers of the world.

faq.answer: Gloomtide Strand is a coastal area along western Darkshore, characterized by cold ocean tides, overcast skies, and the wild, untamed nature of northern Kalimdor's shoreline.
The strand lies within the traditional ancestral lands of the night elves, who hold domain over Darkshore as part of the Alliance.

faq.q: Is there a settlement or camp here?
faq.answer: No permanent settlement exists along this open shore. It remains a wild stretch of coastal wilderness typical of Darkshore's fog-laden beaches.

angles.text: The shores of Darkshore are part of your ancestral lands, watched over by the Sentinels and the druids who seek balance with Kalimdor's wilderness.
Darkshore represents a vital night elf stronghold along northern Kalimdor's coast, securing the waterways below Teldrassil.
